headline_metrics.sos_phones_extraction_note: Combined extraction: tel: links + JSON-embedded `"phone"` fields (bare and escaped variants) in the RSC payload. Per-destination range: 0-4 phones. 3 destinations returned 0 phones (candolim/mysore/ajanta-caves) — these are honest-scarcity nulls, not fabrications. The sole invalid phone is `Contact via Kohima tourism office` published for Khonoma (NEW-2026-05-11-001 STILL OPEN — REPRODUCED today, fix has not landed). All other 13 phones conform to Indian phone formats (short code 112, STD-prefixed landlines 0135-/0370-/0651-). Separately, a targeted re-test of Uttarkashi confirmed NEW-2026-05-10-001 (`+91-94120-XXXXX` placeholder) is REPRODUCED today.
headline_metrics.sos_uttarkashi_targeted_retest_note: Targeted re-test (outside the random shuf sample) — phones extracted: ['+91-1374-222123', '+91-94120-XXXXX', '0135-2559898', '1070', '112']. The placeholder `+91-94120-XXXXX` (Taxi Union) is still served. Fix from 2026-05-10 has not landed.
